    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

}
for dn in (1,2):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {dn} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {dn} output']
    h=len(I);w=len(I[0]);r0=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if all(x==3 for x in r)][0];c0=[j for j,x in enumerate(I[0]) if all(r[j]==3 for r in I)][0]
    res=[]
    for qname,(ri,ci) in [('TL',(range(r0),range(c0))),('TR',(range(r0),range(c0+1,w))),('BL',(range(r0+1,h),range(c0))),( 'BR',(range(r0+1,h),range(c0+1,w)))]:
        for nm,cond in conditions.items():
            tot=mism=0
            for i in ri:
                for j in ci:
                    if qname=='TL': u,v = r0-1-i, c0-1-j
                    elif qname=='TR': u,v = r0-1-i, w-1-j
                    elif qname=='BL': u,v = h-1-i, c0-1-j

                    tot+=1

            res.append((nm,mism/tot))

        print(' ',nm,f'{bad:.3f}')
